episodes.title: Why are there unicorns in the KJV?
episodes.description:
#maklelan3559

A portion of a Data Over Dogma episode in which Dan Beecher and I look at the unicorns of the King James Bible: where the translation came from, what animal the Hebrew word probably referred to, and why Deuteronomy 33:17 shows it had more than one horn. Then we look at the different words the KJV translates as ‘hell’: Sheol, Gehenna and Hades.
 
Full episode on YouTube: Is the King James Bible Crap?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l_GISprZkIo
New Data Over Dogma episodes every week: https://www.youtube.com/@dataoverdogma
 
0:00 Unicorns in the KJV
0:52 Tyndale and the Vulgate
2:29 What animal was it?
2:55 Rhinoceroses and Greek travelers’ tales
4:44 Deuteronomy 33:17: more than one horn
6:55 The hyrax
8:53 The words translated ‘hell’
9:41 Sheol
10:32 Gehenna and the Tophet
11:45 Hades
12:10 What if they had stayed separate?

episodes.title: Who were the Nephilim? (Data Over Dogma)
episodes.description:
#maklelan3557

 portion of a Data Over Dogma episode in which Dan Beecher and I read Genesis 6:1-4: what it actually says about the sons of God and the daughters of humans, why ‘Nephilim’ doesn’t mean giants, how the Nephilim turn up again after the flood in Numbers 13, why the passage looks like a later insertion, and who the sons of God originally were.
 
Full episode on YouTube: Who are the REAL Christians?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yviFHESG_HA
New Data Over Dogma episodes every week: https://www.youtube.com/@dataoverdogma

episodes.title: All about Elohim! (Data Over Dogma)
episodes.description:
#maklelan3555

A portion of a Data Over Dogma episode in which Dan Beecher and I look at the word Elohim: how Deuteronomy uses it, why ‘the Lord your God’ identifies one god among many rather than declaring there is only one, how Yahweh probably wasn’t Israel’s first patron deity, how he was merged with El, and how the divine name was pronounced.
 
Full episode on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WE6DwFyEurs
New Data Over Dogma episodes every week at https://www.youtube.com/@dataoverdogma

1:57 Monotheism?
2:53 Deuteronomy 32:8-9 and the Most High
4:25 When to capitalize ‘God’
6:30 Yahweh probably wasn’t Israel’s first god
6:57 Israel and El
8:48 Yahweh joins El’s pantheon
9:26 When two become one
10:23 The tetragrammaton and how to say it
